note: 桥接句称november-birth-flower页面追溯了'为什么生日花清单常成对出现而不像生辰石那样单一'这一缺口，归因于19世纪互相竞争的花卉词典、缺少像生辰石行业那样的统一贸易会议。目标文章body原文：'This site's [August birth flower] page traced why a page like this one keeps landing on two flowers instead of one: unlike birthstones, which the jewelry trade standardized in a single 1912 convention, birth flowers never had one body settle the question. Rival 19th-century floriography guides couldn't agree with each other, and rather than pick a winner, the trade lists that followed kept both.' —— 与桥接句断言（19世纪多方花语词典竞争、没有对应生辰石1912年贸易会议的统一裁决）完全吻合。
